title: Semi-Ordered Permutation
summary: Given a permutation nums of length n, return the minimum number of adjacent swaps needed so that the first element is 1 and the last element is n.
officialConstraints: 2 <= nums.length == n <= 50; 1 <= nums[i] <= 50; nums is a permutation.
visualizationNotes: Input is a permutation of 1..n with n between 2 and 50; the view shows the array and the indices of 1 and n.
